subject: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)

Team —

Late-stage ask from Forge Manufacturing (see attached RFP summary). They're evaluating Redwood for a factory-scale digital-twin project (real-time telemetry + inference at the edge). Procurement has asked for 2 x 30–45 minute reference conversations with customers who have:

- deployed Redwood in a regulated manufacturing environment (EU)
- integrated with OT/PLC systems and ingesting high-frequency telemetry
- seen measurable latency/cost improvements after batching + KV caching

Deal details (short): DEAL-2027-0458, expected decision by end of March, opportunity > $500k ARR if we get through procurement. Forge wants the references to speak to integration effort, reliability, and performance at 1M tokens/day-ish.

Can each of you flag any customers you think would be a credible fit and willing to speak? Priority: EU-based manufacturing companies. I'm aiming to have a shortlist by EOD Monday 2/22 so we can coordinate scheduling.

Attachments: MCP_RFP_Summary.pdf (high level)

Ideal ask to the advocates would be: 30 min intro + 15 min focused Q&A (security, SLA, integration). We will provide an outline of questions and a short prep note.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
t: +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)

Tessa —

Quick thoughts:
- Revon Systems (Michael Chu) is a strong fit — EU footprint, did a brownfield integration with several PLC vendors and used our Dedicated offering for throughput-critical inference. They were responsive in the last RFP and have been positive about our latency profiles. I have contact with Michael — he usually agrees to short references for late-stage deals.
- Icarus Robotics (not EU HQ but EMEA ops) could be a backup; they emphasized quantization work.

I'll attach the case notes I pulled last quarter (revon-case-study-summary.docx). If we want a security-forward advocate, we might need to look at a customer in life sciences or energy, but that may be overkill for Forge.

Marissa
Customer Advocates
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)

+1 for Revon (Michael). I spoke with their CS lead in November — they're open to short calls and care most about deterministic tail latency and predictable unit cost. Michael's time window next week: Tue 2/23 14:00–16:00 CET or Wed 2/24 09:00–11:00 CET.

I'll make a soft ask if you want me to; otherwise Tessa can reach out directly.

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@forge-manufacturing.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)

Elena —

Thanks again for the time on the demo earlier this week. Per procurement's request, we'd like to line up a short customer reference call so you can hear from someone who has run Redwood against a similar manufacturing use case.

Suggested advocate: Michael Chu, Head of Cloud Integrations at Revon Systems (cc'd on our side). Michael has run Redwood in an EU production environment and can speak to integration nuances and performance.

Proposed slots (CEST):
- Tue, 23 Feb 2027, 14:00–14:45 CEST
- Wed, 24 Feb 2027, 09:30–10:15 CEST

We've attached a one-page reference question guide to keep the call focused (reference-questions.pdf). If either of those times work, we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda. If Forge needs an NDA or additional compliance materials ahead of the call, let me know — we can escalate to security/compliance for documentation.

Thanks, and copying Marissa/Vanessa to coordinate scheduling.

Best regards,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@forge-manufacturing.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Customer advocate alignment request — Forge Manufacturing (manufacturing digital-twin)

Tessa —

Thanks, that looks great. Wed 24 Feb 2027 09:30–10:15 CEST works for Forge; please send the calendar invite. A couple of quick asks from procurement/security ahead of the call:

1) Can the advocate speak to network isolation and whether they used Dedicated vs Hosted for PCI/OT segregation?
2) Any documentation on retention/audit logs we can share?

If possible, please have Marissa or Michael call out the integration effort (3rd-party PLC adapters), and timing of the initial pilot to production cutover. We'll keep the call to 30–40 minutes.

I'll accept the DocuSign NDA if you prefer to have something in place — otherwise a short email confirmation is fine.

Elena Rossi
Procurement Manager
Forge Manufacturing
